blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Inserting virtual objects into scenes reconstructed via 2D or 3D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS/3DGS) is a key capability for content creation, AR, and synthetic data generation. However, realistic insertion requires the object to be seamlessly lit by the scene and, conversely, to cast physically plausible shadows onto it. Existing approaches either harmonize appearance in image space, sacrificing multi-view consistency, or approximate scene illumination with an environment map at the insertion point, which cannot represent near-field area lights such as windows and lamps that dominate indoor lighting. To address this, we present GraftRay, a unified method for physically consistent insertion of mesh objects into indoor scenes represented by either 2D or 3D Gaussians. We recover scene materials and surface normals with diffusion-based priors, and explicitly model spatially-extended emitters, solving their radiance in closed form. A hybrid renderer then jointly path-traces the scene Gaussians and inserted meshes, producing view-consistent shading, interreflections, and soft shadows. On FIPT, GraftRay sets a new state of the art, outperforming recent baselines such as ComGS and EAG-PT in rendering fidelity and shadow accuracy, while maintaining highly competitive rendering efficiency.
blocks.zh: 将虚拟对象插入到通过2D或3D高斯平板重建的场景中(2DGS/3DGS)是内容生成,AR,和合成数据生成的关键能力. 然而,现实的插入要求物体被现场无缝地点燃,反之,将物理上可信的阴影投入其中. 现有方法要么将图像空间的外观相统一,牺牲多视图的一致性,要么在插入点用环境图进行近似场景照明,这不能代表以室内照明为主的窗户和灯光等近地区域灯光. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了GraftRay,一种在物理上一致地将网状物体插入由2D或3D高斯人代表的室内场景的统一方法. 我们回收场景材料和表面常态,以扩散为主的前兆,并明确模拟空间延伸的发射器,以封闭的形式解决它们的光能. 混合渲染器随后联合追踪了场景高斯人并插入了 meshes,产生了与景色相符合的阴影,相互折射,和柔软的阴影. 在FIPT上,GraftRay设定了一种新的技术水平,在保持高度竞争性的渲染效率的同时,在提供忠诚度和阴影精确度方面优于ComGS和EAG-PT等近期基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 21 ] and its 2D counterpart [ 15 ] enable high-quality, real-time rendering of reconstructed scenes. However, inserting a virtual object into such scenes remains challenging. Beyond matching its appearance to the background, the inserted object must respond to the scene’s illumination, cast geometrically consistent shadows, and contribute indirect light to surrounding surfaces. Achieving these effects requires explicit light transport while preserving the visual fidelity of the original reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 3D Gaussian Splateting (3DGS) [21] 及其2D对应[15] 使得重建的场景能够高质量,实时的渲染. 然而,在这种场景中插入一个虚拟物体仍然具有挑战性。 除了将其外观与背景相匹配外,插入的物体必须响应场景的光线,铸造几何一致的阴影,并将间接光线贡献给周围的表面. 实现这些效果需要明确的轻便运输,同时保持原始重建的视觉可靠性.

blocks.en: Existing approaches address this problem from three main directions. Environment-map-based methods estimate local illumination from HDR environment maps [ 2 , 26 , 16 ] . Although effective for approximating incident illumination, environment maps do not explicitly represent the spatial positions of local emitters or their interactions with scene geometry, limiting their ability to reproduce spatially varying illumination and geometrically consistent shadows. Inverse-rendering methods jointly recover scene materials and illumination [ 28 , 8 , 13 , 47 , 29 , 37 , 3 ] . While physically grounded, these methods introduce additional unknowns beyond those strictly required for object insertion. Moreover, low-dynamic-range (LDR) observations weaken the photometric constraints needed to distinguish emissive sources from highly reflective surfaces. Finally, image-space harmonization methods use generative models to refine the appearance of composited objects [ 36 , 42 , 38 , 24 ] . Despite producing visually plausible results, they do not explicitly model scene-level light transport and therefore cannot guarantee consistent relighting when the object or illumination changes.
blocks.zh: 现有办法从三个主要方向解决这一问题。 基于环境图的方法从《人类发展报告》的环境图中估算出当地照明量[2、26、16]。 虽然对近似事件照明有效,但环境图并不明确代表当地发射者的空间位置或其与场景几何的相互作用,限制了它们复制空间变化的照明和几何一致的阴影的能力. 反向递减方法联合回收现场材料和照明[28,8,13,47,29,37,3]. 这些方法虽然有实际依据,但除了插入物体所严格需要的以外,还增加了未知数。 此外,低动力测距(LDR)观测削弱了将发射源与高度反射的表面区分开来所需的测光限制。 最后,图像空间协调方法使用基因模型来完善复合物体的外观[36,42,38,24]. 尽管产生了可视的可视效果,但它们没有明确的模拟场景级光传输,因此无法保证物体或照明改变时的连续重燃.

blocks.en: We propose GraftRay , a unified framework for physically consistent object insertion into 2D and 3D Gaussian scenes ( Fig. 1 ). Because our pipeline extracts material priors directly from rendered views rather than relying on original capture data, it uniquely supports physically-based insertion even for synthetically generated Gaussian scenes where original training images are unavailable. We first render multi-view images from the Gaussian scene and estimate material properties, including albedo, roughness, metallicity, and normals, using robust 2D estimators such as RGB-X or diffusion-based models. These predictions are then unprojected onto individual 2D/3D Gaussians to provide scene-level material attributes, bypassing the complex joint optimization of traditional inverse rendering. Building on these attributes, we extend an OptiX-accelerated path tracer to support Gaussian primitives with stochastic transparency [ 9 ] and 3 ​ σ 3\sigma axis-aligned bounding boxes, traced jointly with inserted meshes. The extended path tracer incorporates a Mitsuba-style path integration scheme [ 17 ] , analytic area emitters, multiple importance sampling (MIS), and explicit shadow rays to enable light transport directly on Gaussian scenes. We further recover scene illumination from LDR observations by treating saturated pixels as lower-bound constraints and using unsaturated surfaces to constrain emitter intensities. Since light transport is linear in emitter intensities with fixed geometry and materials, we precompute unit-radiance basis images and formulate light estimation as a nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) problem. Finally, we use differential rendering [ 7 ] to introduce the inserted object’s shadows and indirect illumination while preserving the original background reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Graftray, 用于物理上一致的物体插入到2D和3D高斯场景(图1)的统一框架. 因为我们的管道直接从所显示的视图中提取材料的前兆,而不是依赖原始的捕捉数据,因此它特别支持基于物理的插入,甚至对于合成生成的没有原始训练图像的高斯场景而言. 我们首先利用RGB-X或扩散模型等强力的2D估计器,从高斯场景中渲染出多视图图像,并估算材料属性,包括反照率,粗糙度,金属度,和常态. 这些预测随后被解析到单个2D/3D高斯人身上,以提供场景级物质属性,绕过传统反向渲染的复杂联合优化. 基于这些属性,我们扩展了一个OptiX加速路径跟踪器,以支持高斯原始人,其结构透明性[9]和3⁄3\sigma轴连接的框,与插入的网格连接追踪。 扩展路径追踪器包含一种米特苏巴式路径集成方案[17],分析区发射器,多重重要取样(MIS),以及清晰的阴影射线,使光能直接传送到高斯的场景. 我们进一步从LDR观测中恢复场景照明,将饱和像素作为下限约束,并利用不饱和表面限制排放强度. 由于光传输在发射强度上是线性的,有固定的几何和材料,所以我们预先计算单位辐射基础图像,并将光线估计成一个非负最小方(NNLS)问题. 最后,我们使用差分渲染 [7] 在保留原始背景重建的同时引入插入对象的阴影和间接照明.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • From LDR images alone, we unproject multi-view 2D material and normal predictions onto individual 2D/3D Gaussians, providing scene-level material attributes for physically based insertion without joint inverse rendering. • We extend an OptiX path tracer to trace stochastic-transparency Gaussians jointly with meshes, computing illumination, shadows, and indirect light between Gaussian scenes and mesh objects, while differential rendering preserves the reconstruction. • We formulate light-intensity estimation using censored observations and path-traced radiance bases, exploiting unsaturated illumination cues to distinguish true emitters from bright reflectors and efficiently estimate nonnegative emitter intensities.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Classical object insertion relies on differential rendering [ 7 ] , which combines a captured scene with an estimate of its illumination; Karsch et al . [ 20 ] extended this paradigm to single photographs. Subsequent methods estimate illumination from images using learned HDR environment maps [ 11 ] , spatially varying lighting [ 12 , 25 ] , or lighting volumes [ 39 ] . Diffusion-based approaches further improve illumination estimation and adaptation: DiffusionLight [ 35 ] synthesizes environment-map observations through a rendered chrome ball, while DiPIR [ 26 ] uses a diffusion model as a critic for lighting optimization. GaSLight [ 2 ] lifts ordinary images into HDR Gaussian splats, LightHarmony3D [ 16 ] predicts environment maps for hybrid Gaussian–mesh rendering, and LuxRemix [ 27 ] decomposes indoor illumination into editable components. Unlike approaches that primarily estimate environment maps or distribute emissive radiance across scene representations, GraftRay explicitly parameterizes local area emitters and uses them in path-traced light transport, allowing their spatial extent and scene occlusion to affect illumination and shadows.
blocks.zh: 古典物体的插入依赖于差分渲染[7],它结合了被捕获的场景和对其光度的估计;Karsch等人.[20]把这个范式扩展到了单张照片. 其后的方法利用学到的HDR环境图[11],空间变化的照明[12,25],或照明卷[39],对图像进行照明估计。 基于扩散的方法进一步改善了照明估计和适应: DifunationLight[35]通过一个渲染的铬球合成环境图观测,而DIPIR[26]则使用扩散模型作为照明优化的批评者. GASLight [2] 将普通的图像提升到HDR高斯版,LightHarmony3D [16] 预测混合高斯版-mesh渲染的环境图,LuxRemix [27] 将室内照明分解为可编辑组件. 与主要估计环境图或将发射光分分布于场景示意图的方法不同,GraftRay明确参数化了局部区域发射器,并将其用于路径跟踪光传输,允许其空间范围及场景隔离影响照明和阴影.

blocks.en: Recent methods use generative priors to improve the visual consistency of inserted objects in reconstructed scenes. MV-CoLight [ 36 ] generates multi-view-consistent lighting and shadows, while Violante et al . [ 42 ] harmonize composite images with diffusion models and consolidate the results into 3DGS. D3DR [ 38 ] similarly uses diffusion priors for zero-shot 3DGS harmonization. Other approaches explore alternative scene representations and insertion strategies: ComGS [ 10 ] composes objects using surface octahedral probes, and FreeInsert [ 24 ] inserts text-specified objects without requiring explicit spatial priors. Related 2D methods include image harmonization [ 6 ] , diffusion-based object relighting [ 19 ] , token-space relighting from sparse views [ 5 ] , and geometry-guided video insertion with GO-Renderer [ 14 ] . GaussianEditor [ 4 ] explores direct editing of 3DGS scenes. These methods primarily target perceptual consistency or generative scene editing, whereas GraftRay explicitly models light transport to produce view-consistent shadows and indirect illumination for inserted objects.
blocks.zh: 近代方法使用基因前传,提高被插入物体在重建场景中的视觉一致性. MV-CoLight [36] 生成多视图一致的照明和阴影,而Violante et al. [42] 将复合图像与扩散模型协调,并将结果整合为3DGS. D3DR [38] 类似使用扩散前缀进行零射3DGS协调. 其他方法探索其他场景表示和插入策略: ComGS [10] 使用表面八面体探测器编造物体, FreeInsert [24] 插入文字指定的物体而不需要明确的空间前缀. 相关的2D方法包括图像协调[6],基于扩散的物体重燃[19],从稀少的视图重燃符号空间[5],以及用GO-渲染器插入几何制导的视频[14]. 高斯编辑器 [4]探索直接编辑3DGS场景. 这些方法主要针对感知一致性或基因场景编辑,而Graftray则明确模拟光传输,为插入的物体产生与视觉一致的阴影和间接照明.

blocks.en:
Neural inverse rendering initially developed around radiance fields [ 31 ] , factorizing geometry, reflectance, and illumination [ 48 , 18 ] with ray tracing for indoor scenes [ 49 ] . For Gaussians, GS-IR [ 28 ] and GS-ID [ 8 ] recover per-Gaussian BRDFs under environment maps or spherical Gaussians. GI-GS [ 3 ] and IRGS [ 13 ] incorporate global illumination, with IRGS employing differentiable 2D Gaussian ray tracing. NeILF++ [ 47 ] couples incident and outgoing light fields, while IRIS [ 29 ] addresses indoor LDR reconstruction by estimating camera responses. Intrinsic diffusion priors [ 46 , 23 ] and factorized inverse path tracing [ 43 ] offer alternative material decomposition strategies.
Among these, AEGIR [ 37 ] is closely related, jointly optimizing area emitters, materials, and geometry via a differentiable deferred renderer. Similarly, EAG-PT [ 44 ] reconstructs emission-aware 2DGS with albedo only for path-traced editing. Unlike these joint factorizations, GraftRay targets object insertion with a constrained optimization: we initialize scene materials from priors and optimize emitter radiances while keeping geometry and materials fixed, reducing coupled unknowns and enabling explicit handling of saturated LDR observations.
blocks.zh:
神经反向渲染最初围绕辐射场[31]发展,将几何,反射,光线化[48,18],对室内场景进行射线跟踪[49]. 对于高斯人,GS-IR[28]和GS-ID[8]在环境图或球形高斯人下回收每名高斯人BDF. GI-GS [3]和IRGS [13] 包含全球照明,IRGS采用不同的2D高斯射线跟踪. NeILF++[47]情侣事件和外出光场,而IRIS[29]则通过估计摄像头反应来解决室内LDR重建. 内消散前导[46,23]和因子化反向路径追踪[43]提供了替代的材料分解策略.
其中,AEGIR[37]是紧密相连的,通过不同的延迟渲染器,共同优化区域发射器,材料和几何. 同样,EAG-PT[44]重建排放意识2DGS,只用于路径跟踪编辑. 与这些联合因子化不同,GraftRay瞄准对象插入时有限制优化:我们从前作中初始化场景材料,并优化发射光度,同时保持几何学和材料固定,减少偶联未知数,并允许明确处理饱和LDR观测.

blocks.en: Recent methods have extended ray tracing to Gaussian and particle-based representations. 3DGRT [ 32 ] traces particle scenes using ray-tracing hardware, bounding individual primitives and evaluating their responses along rays. EVER [ 30 ] supports exact ellipsoid rendering for view synthesis, while GHPT [ 1 ] combines rasterization and path tracing for real-time relightable Gaussian splats. Building on these efforts, we extend an OptiX-accelerated path tracer to support light transport directly on Gaussian scenes. Our approach shares the peak-response intersection strategy with 3DGRT but targets physical illumination rather than view synthesis. Stochastic hit acceptance [ 40 ] accounts for Gaussian transparency during ray traversal, enabling Monte Carlo light-transport estimation with analytic area emitters, multiple importance sampling, and next-event estimation.
blocks.zh: 近代方法将射线跟踪扩展到了高斯和粒子的表达. 3DGRT [32] 利用射线跟踪硬件追踪粒子场景,将单个原始人捆绑在一起,并沿射线评估其反应. EVER [30] 支持精确椭圆形渲染用于视图合成,而GHPT [1] 结合光栅化和路径跟踪用于实时可重燃的高斯星板. 在这些努力的基础上,我们扩展了一个OptiX加速路径跟踪器,支持在高斯大陆场景上直接进行光传输. 我们的方法与3DGRT共享峰值反应交叉策略,但针对的是物理照明而不是视图合成. Stochastic hit recept [40] 说明高斯人在射线穿梭过程中的透明度,使得蒙特卡洛能够用分析区发射器进行光传输估计,多重重要性取样,以及下一个事件估计.

user-marked light regions, our method estimates scene illumination

blocks.en: Each emitter is manually specified by the user through a 2D mask, while its geometry and radiance are estimated automatically. The user marks light-emitting regions, such as windows, lamps, and ceiling panels, using SAM [ 22 ] in one or a few views. We back-project the masked pixels onto the Gaussians using the visibility test in Sec. 3.1 , obtaining a 3D point set for each emitter. Each emitter is represented as an analytic, one-sided rectangle E j E_{j} , parameterized by its centre, in-plane axes, half-extents, and normal. We fit a plane to each point set using RANSAC weighted towards bright Gaussians, then refine the plane using PCA on the inliers. This weighting favours bright surfaces when estimating the emitter geometry. For wall-mounted emitters, we align the in-plane axes with the horizontal and vertical directions; otherwise, we use the PCA axes. The emitter’s extent is determined from the Gaussians associated with the fitted plane, and its normal is oriented towards the room. The resulting emitter candidates are subsequently refined during radiance estimation in Sec. 3.5 , allowing candidates with little contribution to the observed illumination to be suppressed.

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.1 比较

blocks.en:
We compare our method with recent approaches in inverse rendering, illumination estimation, image harmonization, and feed-forward relighting. We use the released implementations of the baselines and follow their respective optimization protocols on our datasets. As shown in Table 1 , our method achieves the best overall performance on FIPT and NFINITE, particularly in shadow reconstruction. Compared with inverse rendering methods, our near-field emitter representation yields more accurate shadows under a controlled rendering setup. Illumination estimation methods such as GaSLight struggle to recover accurate insertion shadows, while image harmonization methods such as MV-CoLight cannot reliably reproduce cast shadows through appearance adjustment alone. Similarly, feed-forward relighting methods produce plausible relit appearances but fail to reconstruct spatially accurate shadows. VQAScore barely separates the methods on the real and generated scenes. Qualitative comparisons are shown in Figs. 3 and 4 . On the synthetic scenes, ours
reproduces the object brightness and the contact shadows, whereas the baselines miss the shadows or
misjudge the brightness ( Fig. 3 ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.3 限制

blocks.en:
Our method has two main limitations. First, the light sources must be marked
manually: the user selects windows and lamps with SAM in one or a few views,
although only approximate masks are needed. Second, it relies on prior
information: albedo, roughness, metallic and normals come from 2D estimators
(RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X or DiffusionRenderer), so errors in these priors carry
over to the fitted lights and the insertion.

虽然只需要大概的面具。 第二,它依赖于先前

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We recover sampleable area emitters (geometry, orientation and absolute
radiance) from ordinary LDR multi-view captures of indoor scenes by treating
saturated pixels as censored observations. With a stochastic-transparency path
tracer over the Gaussians, inserted objects receive spatially varying shading,
contact shadows and bounce light without degrading the reconstruction. With geometry and
materials fixed, the light estimate is a low-dimensional fit
over path-traced basis images. We also show that full-image metrics barely reflect lighting,
and give a protocol that isolates the insertion effect.
